elements.name: a few lights stretched sideways into short streaks

wrong_setting: A large portrait of a girl with brown hair and a grey top fills the centre of the frame. The scene should hold no people, only blurred city lights, so this reads as a portrait against a planet- or bokeh-like backdrop.
notes: Regenerate with no person: fill the whole frame edge to edge with soft amber, white, red and teal bokeh glows on blue-black, include a few short sideways streaks, and remove the rounded-corner paper edge.
